svg.title: Data assistant request
svg.desc: 1. The browser calls the API, which forwards the question to the user's own agent through a self-hosted agent gateway. 2. The agent calls back into Q-NEXUS on a read-only MCP endpoint that accepts only per-user agent tokens. 3. Each request builds a fresh MCP server for that user; every tool reads the same scoped workspace as the user's screens, with prices removed for roles that may not see them. 4. No tool accepts a user id and none can write, so the agent can never see or change more than its user.
